summary: Ascendis Pharma A/S filed a Form 6-K as a foreign private issuer disclosing that the EMA's Committee for Orphan Medicinal Products adopted a positive opinion recommending maintenance of orphan medicinal product designation for once-weekly TransCon CNP (navepegritide) in pediatric achondroplasia. The designation would confer ten years of EU orphan market exclusivity upon European Commission adoption, following a positive CHMP opinion for marketing authorization in children aged two and older with open epiphyses. Final EC decision is expected in Q4 2026, with a first German launch as YUVIWEL expected in Q1 2027. No transaction, capital event or special situation; a routine regulatory milestone disclosure.
